newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rauma says sells U.S. pipe inspection unit.
newsitem.headline: Rauma says sells U.S. pipe inspection unit.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said in a statement on Monday it had sold its U.S. pipeline inspection company Vetco Pipeline Services to Tuboscope Pipeline Services for an undisclosed sum.
"The company divestment will not have a material effect on Rauma's results for the current year," it said.
Vetco's net sales for the 12 months to July 31 were about 55 million markka, and it has 86 employees, Rauma said.

The divestment will strengthen Rauma's focus on its main business groups: Timberjack (forest machines), Sunds Defibrator (fiber processing technology), Nordberg (rock crushing equipment) and Neles-Jamesbury (industrial valves), it said.
